label: Limit benchmark plan: DRAGON2 B/C against the closed-form 1D thin-disc model of theory:cr-secondary-ratio (profiles/theory/cr-secondary-ratio/scripts/predict.py). Declared before any DRAGON2 B/C value was compared with predict.py.

common_settings.grid: 2D (R, z), Rmax = 20 kpc, DimR = 41, z equidistant with dz = 0.02 kpc (DimZ = 2 L / 0.02 + 1), observer at (8.3, 0, 0) kpc
common_settings.energy_grid: Ek per nucleon 0.5 to 2000 GeV/n, factor 1.2
common_settings.flags: diffusion on, convection off, reacceleration off, energy losses off, radioactive decay off (Flags block, child elements)
common_settings.diffusion: Constant: D = D0 beta^etaT (R / DiffRefRig)^delta with etaT = 1, DiffRefRig = 1 GV, delta = 0.5 (same form as predict.py with R0 = 1 GV)
common_settings.gas: BronfFerr (analytic HI and H2; HII = 0); the closed form gets h n_H from the same formulas summed on DRAGON2's own z grid at R = 8.3 kpc (h = 0.1 kpc, n_H = column / (2 h))
common_settings.sources: OneRing with RingMin = 0, RingMax = Rmax: uniform in R, |z| <= 0.2 kpc
common_settings.cross_sections: type DRAGON2 with its production table replaced in the run's data directory by the profile's ILLUSTRATIVE set A: 6012 -> 5011 = 70 mb and 8016 -> 5011 = 35 mb at every tabulated energy, every other channel absent (8016 -> 6012 present at 0 mb only to define the table's energy grid). Inelastic cross sections stay DRAGON2's own parametrization (not replaceable through data), and the helium target (He/H = 0.11, constants.h) stays on (not switchable without changing the code)
common_settings.observed_parent_ratio: the closed form takes r_O = N_O / N_C from the same DRAGON2 run at each energy (an input of the closed form, not a fitted value)

D_X3_R30.note: diagnostic only (no tolerance): X3 with Rmax = 30 kpc, DimR = 61, sources to 30 kpc, run after C2 failed, to test whether the radial boundary causes the X3 deviation

D_X1_R60.note: diagnostic only (no tolerance): X1 with Rmax = 60 kpc, DimR = 121, sources to 60 kpc

D_X3_R60.note: diagnostic only (no tolerance): X3 with Rmax = 60 kpc, DimR = 121, sources to 60 kpc

D_X1_R60_UG.note: diagnostic only: as D_X1_R60 with DRAGON2 patched (dragon2-gas-fixed-r.patch) so that the BronfFerr gas is evaluated at R = 8.3 kpc at every radius

D_X2_R60_UG.note: diagnostic only: X2 with Rmax = 60 kpc and the gas patch

D_X3_R60_UG.note: diagnostic only: X3 with Rmax = 60 kpc and the gas patch

checks.what: B/C of run X1 divided by the closed form at the same E/n nodes (DRAGON2's own energy nodes between 10 and 1000 GeV/n)
checks.reason: not like-for-like in four known ways that this test cannot remove: (1) the helium target (He/H = 0.11) raises both production and destruction, expected to raise B/C by of order 10-20% where escape dominates; (2) DRAGON2's own energy-dependent inelastic cross sections replace the profile's 250/270/310 mb; (3) 2D geometry: radially varying gas (H2 peak near 8 kpc), a finite radial boundary at 20 kpc and sources uniform in R; (4) finite thickness of gas (HWHM 0.06-0.12 kpc) and sources (|z| <= 0.2 kpc) against the thin-disc limit. 30% is the sum of rough magnitudes of these effects, chosen before the comparison; it is a consistency check, not a validation of either code

checks.what: B/C of X2 and X3 divided by B/C of X1 (same D0/L) at DRAGON2's energy nodes between 10 and 1000 GeV/n
checks.reason: the 1D thin-disc model depends on D0 and L only through D0/L exactly; DRAGON2 breaks this through the finite gas and source thickness (h/L from about 0.1 at L = 2 to 0.025 at L = 8) and radial escape (boundary 11.7 kpc from the observer against L up to 8 kpc); 10% bounds corrections of order h/L plus the radial term

checks.what: least-squares slope of ln(B/C) against ln(E/n) over DRAGON2's nodes in 100-1000 GeV/n, run X1 against the closed form on the same nodes
checks.reason: both use delta = 0.5; the slope is -delta times the escape fraction, so a 20% difference in effective destruction shifts it by about 0.025; DRAGON2's inelastic cross sections and He/H ratios vary little above 100 GeV/n

checks.what: covariance_fit.py fit, model tabulated-grid, one-axis grid D0 in {2, 3, 4.5} x 1e28 cm^2/s (runs G_low, X1, G_high, L = 4 kpc), measurement = run T_truth (D0 = 3.6e28) bin-averaged in the same bins, with 3% uncorrelated and 2% fully correlated components; every node must pass the comparison gate
checks.reason: multilinear interpolation in ln D0 of a ratio close to D0^-1 between nodes 1.5 apart in D0 biases the interpolated ratio by about (ln 1.5)^2 / 8 = 2%, which maps to about 2% in D0; the data are a DRAGON2 run without noise

never: the tolerances above are not changed after the comparison; a failing check is reported with its likely cause and the test asserts what is established

amendments.why: as declared (three nodes 2, 3, 4.5 x 1e28) the fit could not run: covariance_fit.py raised CovFitError 'point [64.96] (fit coordinates) lies outside the grid [65.17 - 65.98]'. Its Fisher-matrix step is one grid cell, and near the upper edge it takes a second-order one-sided difference that evaluates the model at 2h without checking that 2h stays inside the grid; with three nodes that point leaves the grid. No fit value was obtained, so nothing was compared. The covariance_fit.py behaviour is reported, not changed here (outside this work package)
amendments.change: two more nodes with the same spacing (factor 1.5): runs G_low2 (D0 = 1.333333e28) and G_high2 (D0 = 6.75e28), L = 4 kpc; the grid is D0 in {1.333333, 2, 3, 4.5, 6.75} x 1e28. Measurement, components and tolerance unchanged: |ln(D0_fit / 3.6e28)| <= 0.05

amendments.why: not a tolerance change: a unit correction found when checking the C1 failure. DRAGON2's ASCII output is its internal density per total kinetic energy (dragon.cc writes GetFluxAtSunPosition, which computes weight = A but does not apply it; particle.cc scales the spallation source by A_parent / A_daughter), and dragon2_to_prediction.py now multiplies each column by its mass number A. C1 and C3 were recomputed on the same recorded runs with the same tolerances: C1 now passes (max |ratio - 1| = 0.120 <= 0.30), C3 still passes; C2 is unchanged (same species in numerator and denominator) and still fails. Diagnostic runs D_X1_R60, D_X3_R60 and, with a local gas patch, D_X1_R60_UG, D_X2_R60_UG, D_X3_R60_UG attribute the C2 failure to the radial boundary and radial gas structure
